in_hebrew.name: Hoi
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hoi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the ancient Greek word hoē, meaning 'desired' or 'loved'. In Christianity, the name Hoi is used in reference to the crowd in the New Testament who asked Jesus, 'What must we do to be doing the works of God?'

in_greek.name: Hoi
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Desired, loved
in_greek.long_meaning: Hoi είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the ancient Greek word hoē, meaning 'desired' or 'loved'. In Christianity, the name Hoi is used in reference to the crowd in the New Testament who asked Jesus, 'What must we do to be doing the works of God?'

in_latin.name: Hoi
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Desired, loved
in_latin.long_meaning: Hoi est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the ancient Greek word hoē, meaning 'desired' or 'loved'. In Christianity, the name Hoi is used in reference to the crowd in the New Testament who asked Jesus, 'What must we do to be doing the works of God?'
